## How to read this

- Each ticket has one record under `docs/tickets/`. The record holds the decisions, the
  exact commands that were run, the output that proved the work, and anything deferred.
- The commit history above is the ground truth for *when*; the ticket records are the
  ground truth for *why*. Where they disagree, trust git.
- `PROGRESS.md` at the root is the narrative log, newest first.
- Known hazards and the review procedure are in `docs/REVIEWING.md`.
